title: Harbour clinic access decision
objective: Choose whether to extend the mobile clinic pilot.

sources.title: Pilot service log
sources.text:
The pilot completed 240 appointments in September.
Waiting time fell from 18 days to 11 days.
The log does not establish a causal effect on clinical outcomes.

metrics.quote: The pilot completed 240 appointments in September.

sources.title: Finance review
sources.text:
Operating costs were R180000 in September.
The next quarter funding decision remains open.

recommendations.text: Extend the pilot for one quarter with weekly capacity monitoring.
